conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Meera Joshi. Mera demat account ka annual maintenance charge kyun laga?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Meera ji, main check karta hoon. Kya aap apna demat account number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine dekha, aapke account pe standard annual maintenance charge ₹500 laga hai. Kya aap isey waive karne ke liye eligible hain, main check kar sakta hoon.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Theek hai, aapke trading volume ke basis pe main waive request daal deta hoon. 5 din mein update milega. Koi aur madad?
